title: let it fly (Remix)
lyrics:
Let it fly!

let it fly, fly, fly
let it fly, fly, fly

WHY?!

we get the point 
that's why

its out!

leave it!

duck it!
weave it!
dodge it!

its fast its high
and its above your eye.......
.....let it fly, fly, fly

OR 
.....we loose a point, 
that's..... why...........!!!

leaveing an out ball
and hitting a winner are the same.

get your head in the game


'n'................ let it fly..........!
you win, thats why

resist the earge 
wait for the next one.
